description: Plays one of sixteen recorded snare drum samples, at a playback speed you set and under a decay envelope

params.text: Chooses which of the sixteen samples is played, numbered 1 to 16
Sets the playback speed, and with it the pitch: the recorded speed at centre, 0.01 times speed fully left and twice speed fully right
Sets an exponential decay over the sample, 5ms fully left and the whole length of the chosen sample fully right
Pressing it restarts the sample from its beginning; the lamp in it flashes whenever the module is triggered, from the button or from Trig

inputs.text: Shifts the sample choice, 0.625V moving it by one sample; it is added to the Sample knob and the total held between the first sample and the sixteenth
Shifts the playback speed, 5V covering the whole of the Pitch knob's travel; the total of knob and voltage is held inside that travel
Shifts the decay time, 5V covering the whole of the Decay knob's travel; the total of knob and voltage is held inside that travel
A rising edge past 1V restarts the sample from its beginning
Scales the output level: 0V silences it, 5V gives full level, and anything above 5V counts as 5V

outputs.text: The chosen sample at the set speed under the decay envelope, a full-scale sample reaching ±10V

notes: no sound comes out until the module is triggered, either by a rising edge at Trig or by a press of the button.
the sample number, and the sample length the Decay knob is scaled against, are read at the moment of the trigger; turning Sample part way through a note does not change what is playing.
with Vol unpatched the level is full, so patching a cable that rests at 0V silences the module.

inputs.0:
±10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
0 to 5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 5V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
